quiz_item.scenario_prompt: When evaluating how a machine learning model makes predictions in Artificial Intelligence Requirement 1, why can an AI system produce biased or inaccurate outputs even when its software code has no syntax errors?
quiz_item.question: When evaluating how a machine learning model makes predictions in Artificial Intelligence Requirement 1, why can an AI system produce biased or inaccurate outputs even when its software code has no syntax errors?
options: A. Because machine learning algorithms physically wear out their silicon transistors after processing more than a thousand queries.
B. Because AI models never use training data and instead generate answers using purely random voltage fluctuations.
C. Because computer processors automatically rewrite their own operating systems to ignore human instructions after compilation.

D. Because machine learning models learn statistical patterns from their training data, so unrepresentative, incomplete, or historically skewed data will cause the model to reproduce those biases and errors.
choices: A. Because machine learning algorithms physically wear out their silicon transistors after processing more than a thousand queries.
B. Because AI models never use training data and instead generate answers using purely random voltage fluctuations.
C. Because computer processors automatically rewrite their own operating systems to ignore human instructions after compilation.

D. Because machine learning models learn statistical patterns from their training data, so unrepresentative, incomplete, or historically skewed data will cause the model to reproduce those biases and errors.
quiz_item.correct_answer: D. Because machine learning models learn statistical patterns from their training data, so unrepresentative, incomplete, or historically skewed data will cause the model to reproduce those biases and errors.
quiz_item.explanation: Correct Answer (D): AI and machine learning systems infer patterns directly from training datasets; if the training data contains gaps or historical biases, the resulting model outputs will reflect those flaws, requiring human verification.

requirements.req_text: Practical Application. Do ONE of the following: (a) With your counselor's approval, choose an artificial intelligence project based on your personal interest or a community need. Implement the project utilizing appropriate artificial intelligence tools, languages, or platforms. Share your project with your counselor. Discuss the steps you followed to create the project and your experience during the process. (b) With your counselor's approval, design a short lesson plan on AI and teach it to your patrol or a group of Scouts. The lesson should include an AI-generated age-appropriate explanation of AI, examples of how AI is used in both everyday life as well as in the workplace, and an interactive demonstration of how Scouts could utilize AI to assist them with a school assignment, Scouting activity, or rank advancement. Share information on the development process and teaching experience with your counselor.

options: A. Because machine learning algorithms physically wear out their silicon transistors after processing more than a thousand queries.
B. Because AI models never use training data and instead generate answers using purely random voltage fluctuations.
C. Because computer processors automatically rewrite their own operating systems to ignore human instructions after compilation.

D. Because machine learning models learn statistical patterns from their training data, so unrepresentative, incomplete, or historically skewed data will cause the model to reproduce those biases and errors.
choices: A. Because machine learning algorithms physically wear out their silicon transistors after processing more than a thousand queries.

D. Because machine learning models learn statistical patterns from their training data, so unrepresentative, incomplete, or historically skewed data will cause the model to reproduce those biases and errors.
